checks: Matching modern card JSON and normalized catalog JSON
GET/HEAD, media types, cache/CORS headers, per-body SHA256 ETag, exact conditional 304, POST405, catalog aliases
limitations: Rust requires explicit card URL and catalog identifier; Go derives an absolute URL from Host by default. Comparison normalizes that fixture URL only.
Rust accepts weak/list/wildcard If-None-Match and advertises GET, HEAD in CORS; Go checks exact ETag and advertises GET.
No full schema certification, icon encoding equivalence, proxy/TLS/browser/preflight certification, or live card synchronization.
